name: Sprint Events & Volunteers
author: sprintplugins

sections.description:
Sprint Events & Volunteers helps sports clubs, associations, and nonprofit organizations publish events and coordinate volunteer work.

The free plugin works independently. It provides event and venue management, volunteer missions with multiple time slots, member and guest registrations, confirmation emails, personal schedules, protected management pages, Gutenberg blocks, shortcodes, diagnostics, and WordPress privacy tools.

Events

  • Create events, venues, categories, dates, visibility rules, and registration limits.
  • Publish event lists, monthly calendars, archives, and single-event views.
  • Allow logged-in WordPress users to register or cancel.
  • Review participants from the protected administration screen.

Volunteers

  • Create volunteer missions connected to events.
  • Define several time slots and capacities for each mission.
  • Accept registrations from WordPress accounts or confirmed guests.
  • Provide each volunteer with a personal schedule.
  • Let authorized managers review registrations from a protected front-end portal.

Administration

  • Essential, Complete, and Expert display modes reduce interface density without changing data or permissions.
  • Sprint Club can provide the central display mode and group the plugin screens.
  • A page assistant creates or adopts the required public pages.
  • Site Health, diagnostics, personal-data export, and personal-data erasure are supported.

Optional Pro add-on

A separate commercial add-on can provide advanced email campaigns, approval and waitlist workflows, reminders, attachments, reports, permissions, and configuration transfers. The Pro implementation is not included in this WordPress.org package.

Privacy

For registered users, the plugin can store a WordPress user ID with event and volunteer registrations. For guest volunteer registrations, it can store a first name, last name, email address, optional phone number, confirmation tokens, registration status, and timestamps.

Sprint Events & Volunteers integrates with the WordPress personal-data export and erasure tools. Active operational records may be retained or anonymized when immediate deletion would prevent an organization from managing an ongoing event or volunteer commitment.

The free plugin does not transmit data to an external service. Email messages are sent through the mail system configured for the WordPress site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate Sprint Events & Volunteers.
  2. On activation, the plugin creates or adopts the public pages it needs without overwriting existing content.
  3. Open the Sprint Events & Volunteers menu in WordPress.
  4. Open Settings > Pages to audit, repair, or reassign the public pages when needed.
  5. Configure the Events and Volunteers modules.
  6. Create an event, then add volunteer missions and time slots when needed.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin work without Sprint Club?

Yes. Sprint Club is optional and only groups screens and display-mode preferences.

Can guests register for volunteer missions?

Yes. Guest registrations use a single-use email confirmation link and can be disabled in the settings.

Are the Essential, Complete, and Expert modes separate feature tiers?

No. They only change the amount of administration detail shown. They do not remove data, change permissions, or disable free features.

Does the plugin contact an external service?

No. The free plugin does not send data to an external API. Email delivery uses the mail system configured for the site.

What happens when the plugin is deactivated or uninstalled?

Deactivation preserves all data. Uninstall preserves operational content and registrations by default.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed manual publication of future events while preserving automatic lifecycle transitions.
  • Added automatic mission date prefill from the linked event.
  • Separated event participant sign-ups from volunteer mission registrations through a global module switch.
  • Improved translatable administration labels and refreshed the translation template.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Includes events, venues, volunteer missions, time slots, registrations, public pages, privacy tools, and display modes.
  • Keeps all commercial implementation in the separate Pro add-on.
